script: Your profile is your shop window. Clients decide in about thirty seconds whether to read further, so make those seconds count. Here is a simple formula with five parts. First, your headline. Say what you do, for whom, in one line. For example: Canva designer for small food businesses, in Urdu and English. Second, your photo. Use a clear, friendly, recent photo, taken in good light from a window. If you prefer privacy, a simple logo or a tidy graphic is also fine. Third, your summary. Write three short paragraphs. The first says what you do. The second says who you help. The third says what the client gets. Fourth, your samples. Link your portfolio, and pin your best three pieces to the top. Fifth, your availability. State your hours, your turnaround time, and the languages you work in.
